name: heavy-job-guard
description: Stops Claude from starting a heavy job (typecheck, tests, builds) while another one is already running on the machine.

pattern.title: Heavy job pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression matched against Bash commands and running process command lines. A match is a heavy job.

ignore.title: Ignore pattern
ignore.description: Regular expression for running processes that match the heavy pattern but never finish on their own (editor language servers, watch modes). They never block a job.

mode.title: When a heavy job is already running
mode.description: block refuses the new command and tells Claude to wait; warn lets it run and shows a toast.

subagents.title: Heavy jobs from subagents
subagents.description: allow treats subagents like the main agent; deny refuses every heavy job a subagent starts, so only the main agent runs them.
